name: The Homework Assistant Database
description: A homework assistant works problems step by step with a small set of rules that run locally: type a problem, press Solve, and read the steps. It never pretends to be a live tutor. 2 + 3 = 5. 47 + 58 = 105. 1/2 + 1/4 = 3/4. Everything runs in this browser; no data leaves the page.
